name: G Suite - Drive - New
description: The G Suite - Drive Dashboard provides at-a-glance graphs and detailed analytics on Google Drive activity. The up-to-date G Suite Drive information includes drive activity by location, trends in drive activity by country, ACL changes, counts of primary actions, recent uploads, document types, documents viewed, and documents shared.
title: G Suite - Drive - New

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory = Labs/gsuite/apps "\"applicationName\": \"drive\"" ipAddress
| json "id", "ipAddress", "actor" nodrop
| json field=actor "email"
| json field=id "applicationName"
| where applicationName="drive"
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{applicationName}}" = "*", true, applicationName matches "{{applicationName}}") AND if ("{{ipAddress}}" = "*", true, ipAddress matches "{{ipAddress}}")
|count by ipAddress
| lookup latitude, longitude from geo://location on ip = ipAddress
| where !isNull(latitude)
| sum(_count) as _count by latitude, longitude
| sort by _count

_sourceCategory = Labs/gsuite/apps ""applicationName": "drive"" ""name": "download""
| json "id", "ipAddress", "actor" nodrop
| json field=actor "email"
| json field=id "applicationName"
| parse regex ""name": "doc_title",
\s+"value": "(?<doc_title>[^"]+)"" nodrop // short cut here since doc_title is the same for all event objects
| parse regex "(?<p_Event>\{
\s+"type": "\w+",
\s+"name": "\w+",
\s+"parameters": \[
\s+\{
\s+"name": "primary_event",
\s+"boolValue": true
(?s).+?)(?=,
\s+\{
\s+"type"|
\s+\]
\}$)"
| json field=p_Event "type","name" as eventType, eventName
| where applicationName="drive" and eventName="download"
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{doc_title}}" = "*", true, doc_title matches "{{doc_title}}") AND if ("{{eventType}}" = "*", true, eventType matches "{{eventType}}") AND if ("{{applicationName}}" = "*", true, applicationName matches "{{applicationName}}") AND if ("{{eventName}}" = "*", true, eventName matches "{{eventName}}") AND if ("{{ipAddress}}" = "*", true, ipAddress matches "{{ipAddress}}")
|count by doc_title
| sort  by _count desc

_sourceCategory = Labs/gsuite/apps ""type": "acl_change"" ""applicationName": "drive"" 
| json "id", "ipAddress", "actor" nodrop
| json field=actor "email"
| json field=id "applicationName"
| parse regex "(?<p_Event>\{
\s+"type": "\w+",
\s+"name": "\w+",
\s+"parameters": \[
\s+\{
\s+"name": "primary_event",
\s+"boolValue": true
(?s).+?)(?=,
\s+\{
\s+"type"|
\s+\]
\}$)"
| json field=p_Event "type","name" as eventType, eventName
| where eventType="acl_change" and applicationName="drive"
| parse regex field=p_Event ""name": "doc_title",
\s+"value": "(?<doc_title>[^"]*)"" nodrop
| parse regex field=p_Event ""name": "target_user",
\s+"value": "(?<target_user>[^"]*)"" nodrop
| parse regex field=p_Event ""name": "old_value",
\s+"multiValue": \[
\s+(?<old_value>[^\]]*)\]
" nodrop
| parse regex field=p_Event ""name": "new_value",
\s+"multiValue": \[
\s+(?<new_value>[^\]]*?)\]
" nodrop
| replace (new_value, """, "") as new_value
| replace (old_value, """, "") as old_value
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{doc_title}}" = "*", true, doc_title matches "{{doc_title}}") AND if ("{{eventType}}" = "*", true, eventType matches "{{eventType}}") AND if ("{{applicationName}}" = "*", true, applicationName matches "{{applicationName}}") AND if ("{{target_user}}" = "*", true, target_user matches "{{target_user}}") AND if ("{{eventName}}" = "*", true, eventName matches "{{eventName}}") AND if ("{{ipAddress}}" = "*", true, ipAddress matches "{{ipAddress}}")
|count by eventName, doc_title, old_value, new_value, target_user, email
| fields -_count

_sourceCategory = Labs/gsuite/apps "\"applicationName\": \"drive\"" 
| json "id", "actor", "ipAddress" nodrop
| json field=actor "email", "profileId"
| json field=id "applicationName"
| where applicationName="drive"
| parse regex "(?<p_Event>\{\n\s+\"type\": \"\w+\",\n\s+\"name\": \"\w+\",\n\s+\"parameters\": \[\n\s+\{\n\s+\"name\": \"primary_event\",\n\s+\"boolValue\": true\n(?s).+?)(?=,\n\s+\{\n\s+\"type\"|\n\s+\]\n\}$)"
| json field=p_Event "type","name" as eventType, eventName
| parse regex field=p_Event "\"name\": \"doc_title\",\n\s+\"value\": \"(?<doc_title>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop
| parse regex field=p_Event "\"name\": \"doc_type\",\n\s+\"value\": \"(?<doc_type>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop
| parse regex field=doc_title "[^\?]+?\.(?<doc_ext>[a-zA-Z0-9]{2,4})$"
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{doc_title}}" = "*", true, doc_title matches "{{doc_title}}") AND if ("{{eventType}}" = "*", true, eventType matches "{{eventType}}") AND if ("{{applicationName}}" = "*", true, applicationName matches "{{applicationName}}") AND if ("{{eventName}}" = "*", true, eventName matches "{{eventName}}") AND if ("{{ipAddress}}" = "*", true, ipAddress matches "{{ipAddress}}")
|count by doc_title,doc_type,doc_ext
| if(doc_type="unknown",doc_ext,doc_type) as doc_type
| count_distinct(doc_title) by doc_type
| sort by _count_distinct desc

| json "id", "ipAddress", "actor" nodrop

| json field=id "applicationName"

| timeslice 1h
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{applicationName}}" = "*", true, applicationName matches "{{applicationName}}") AND if ("{{ipAddress}}" = "*", true, ipAddress matches "{{ipAddress}}")

| lookup latitude, longitude, country_name from geo://location on ip = ipAddress
| where !isEmpty(country_name)
| count by _timeslice, country_name
| transpose row _timeslice column country_name as *

_sourceCategory = Labs/gsuite/apps "\"type\": \"acl_change\"" "\"applicationName\": \"drive\"" (can_view OR can_edit OR people_with_link OR public_on_the_web)
| json "id", "actor", "ipAddress" nodrop
| json field=actor "email"
| json field=id "applicationName"
| parse regex "(?<p_Event>\{\n\s+\"type\": \"\w+\",\n\s+\"name\": \"\w+\",\n\s+\"parameters\": \[\n\s+\{\n\s+\"name\": \"primary_event\",\n\s+\"boolValue\": true\n(?s).+?)(?=,\n\s+\{\n\s+\"type\"|\n\s+\]\n\}$)"
| json field=p_Event "type","name" as eventType, eventName
| where eventType="acl_change" and applicationName="drive"
| parse regex field=p_Event "\"name\": \"doc_title\",\n\s+\"value\": \"(?<doc_title>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop
| parse regex field=p_Event "\"name\": \"target_user\",\n\s+\"value\": \"(?<target_user>[^\"]*)\"" nodrop
| parse regex field=p_Event "\"name\": \"new_value\",\n\s+\"multiValue\": \[\n\s+(?<new_value>[^\]]*?)\]\n" nodrop
| replace (new_value, "\"", "") as new_value
| where new_value matches "*can_view*" or new_value matches "*can_edit*" or new_value matches "people_with_link*" or new_value matches "public_on_the_web*"
// edit this line to match your domain
| where !(target_user matches "*acme.com*") and !isEmpty(target_user)
|where if ("{{email}}" = "*", true, email matches "{{email}}") AND if ("{{doc_title}}" = "*", true, doc_title matches "{{doc_title}}") AND if ("{{eventType}}" = "*", true, eventType matches "{{eventType}}") AND if ("{{applicationName}}" = "*", true, applicationName matches "{{applicationName}}") AND if ("{{target_user}}" = "*", true, target_user matches "{{target_user}}") AND if ("{{eventName}}" = "*", true, eventName matches "{{eventName}}") AND if ("{{ipAddress}}" = "*", true, ipAddress matches "{{ipAddress}}")
|count by eventName, doc_title, new_value, target_user, email
| fields -_count
